description: Named the threepence, and left the three words alone.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Asked with the jug in her hand, and hoped the ground was not the point.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Took the greeting as not a grave, and kept his name off the act.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Said he is ashore, refused the larger verdict, and sat.
name: William Shakespeare
